question: Is 120 seconds an acceptable per-inspection cutoff for Docker release verification once the actual Buildx path has been demonstrated?
rationale: Tests establish option wiring, but choosing how much legitimate registry slowness release automation should tolerate is an operational policy judgment without current latency evidence.

options.title: Require exact-path proof
options.body: Ask for an actual verifier or `inspectRaw` stalled-registry timeout plus successful live-registry timings, then accept 120 seconds if the margin is convincing.

options.title: Accept the cutoff now
options.body: Land the fixed 120-second policy while explicitly accepting that unusually slow registry responses may fail a release verification run.

recommendation.title: Require exact-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for an actual verifier or `inspectRaw` stalled-registry timeout plus successful live-registry timings, then accept 120 seconds if the margin is convincing.
